limits: Dense numbers measure one source-informed receiver and one association-anchor partition, not national completion or independent localization accuracy.

Dense timing includes local query, distance sieve, CPA, association scoring and retention. It excludes downloads, imports, index metadata, event preparation, terrain sampling, discovery and refinement.
Point workloads time preloaded-track CPA/scoring; they exclude trajectory loading and query/sieve.
Prepared-index cross-core total comparison establishes exactness and preparation cost, not a total speedup.
Profile data diagnoses remaining work only and is excluded from performance medians.
Three paired repetitions on a shared host establish this measured comparison; they do not guarantee the same ratio for other hardware, partitions or workloads.
